items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: Here's something about you playing drums with Sam Clark's band in Versace.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Played Haymarket Theater. That's the only theater I play in.
Well, that's, that's a very interesting career. Here's something about you playing drums with Sam Clark's band in Versace.
I was at home then, I was in my team. I was a young boy, playing drums. He had all four of them learned how to play drums.
